Tourists keep walking past this café. Big mistake.

AROMA Cafe Bistro Bar Phu Quoc sits inside Happy Bear Hostel on 179 30/4 Street. Easy to miss. 4.9 stars across 557 reviews says you shouldn't.

Coffee, food, drinks, all under one roof. The vibe is relaxed, the crowd is local-ish, and it doesn't scream "tourist trap."

Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
